import ThesisCommon.Analysis.IntegralOperatorBand

/-! On arbitrary finite real measure spaces, the integral-operator band is
the principal band generated by the constant-kernel rank-one operator.
Clipping a nonnegative kernel at natural levels gives increasing operators
dominated by multiples of that rank-one operator, with the original operator
as their actual order supremum. No topological or countability hypothesis is
used on the measure spaces. -/
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Set Topology
open scoped ENNReal ThesisCommon.PositiveOperatorOrder
namespace ThesisCommon
variable {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
variable {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]

omit [IsFiniteMeasure μ] in
theorem constantOneKernel_hasKernelBound :
    HasKernelBound μ ν (fun _ : X × Y => (1 : ℝ)) (ν univ).toReal := by
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro x
  refine ⟨integrable_const 1, ?_⟩
  simp [Measure.real]

/-- The genuine constant-kernel rank-one operator. Zero measure spaces are
included; no normalization by the total mass is performed. -/
def integralRankOne (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν :=
  integralKernelOperator measurable_const constantOneKernel_hasKernelBound

theorem isIntegralKernel_integralRankOne :
    IsIntegralKernel (fun _ : X × Y => (1 : ℝ)) (integralRankOne μ ν) :=
  isIntegralKernel_integralKernelOperator _ _

theorem integralRankOne_isIntegral : IsIntegralOperator (integralRankOne μ ν) :=
  ⟨_, isIntegralKernel_integralRankOne⟩

theorem integralRankOne_nonneg : 0 ≤ integralRankOne μ ν :=
  isIntegralKernel_integralRankOne.positive_of_nonneg_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => zero_le_one)

theorem integralRankOne_apply (f : Lp ℝ 1 μ) :
    integralRankOne μ ν f = (∫ x, f x ∂μ) • lOneIndicator ν univ MeasurableSet.univ := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [isIntegralKernel_integralRankOne.represents f,
    Lp.coeFn_smul (∫ x, f x ∂μ) (lOneIndicator ν univ MeasurableSet.univ),
    lOneIndicator_coe (μ := ν) univ MeasurableSet.univ] with y hy hs hone
  rw [hy, hs, Pi.smul_apply, hone]
  simp

variable {k : X × Y → ℝ} {K : Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν}

theorem IsIntegralKernel.clipped_hasKernelBound (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) (n : ℕ) :
    HasKernelBound μ ν (fun z => min (k z) (n : ℝ)) ‖K‖ := by
  apply hk.hasKernelBound.mono (hk.measurable.min measurable_const)
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro x
  apply Eventually.of_forall
  intro y
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_min (hpos _) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)),
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (hpos _)]
  exact min_le_left _ _

def clippedIntegralOperator (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K) (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) (n : ℕ) :
    Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν :=
  integralKernelOperator (hk.measurable.min measurable_const) (hk.clipped_hasKernelBound hpos n)

theorem isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIntegralKernel (fun z => min (k z) (n : ℝ)) (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos n) :=
  isIntegralKernel_integralKernelOperator _ _

theorem clippedIntegralOperator_nonneg (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos n :=
  (isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos n).positive_of_nonneg_ae
    (Eventually.of_forall fun z => le_min (hpos z) (Nat.cast_nonneg n))

theorem clippedIntegralOperator_le (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) (n : ℕ) : clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos n ≤ K :=
  ((isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos n).le_iff_kernel_le hk).mpr
    (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => min_le_left _ _)

theorem clippedIntegralOperator_le_rankOne (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) (n : ℕ) :
    clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos n ≤ (n : ℝ) • integralRankOne μ ν := by
  apply ((isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos n).le_iff_kernel_le
    (isIntegralKernel_integralRankOne.smul (n : ℝ))).mpr
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => by simpa only [mul_one] using min_le_right (k z) (n : ℝ)

theorem clippedIntegralOperator_monotone (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) : Monotone (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos) := by
  intro m n hmn
  apply ((isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos m).le_iff_kernel_le
    (isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos n)).mpr
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ => min_le_min_left _ (Nat.cast_le.mpr hmn)

theorem clippedIntegralOperator_isLUB (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) : IsLUB (range (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos)) K := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := lOneOperator_exists_isLUB (range_nonempty (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos))
    ⟨K, by rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩; exact clippedIntegralOperator_le hk hpos n⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, hlimit⟩ := exists_integral_kernel_of_monotone_sup
    (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos) (fun n z => min (k z) (n : ℝ))
    (isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos)
    (clippedIntegralOperator_nonneg hk hpos) (clippedIntegralOperator_monotone hk hpos) hU
  have heq : r =ᵐ[μ.prod ν] k := by
    filter_upwards [hlimit] with z hz
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => min (k z) (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (k z)) := by
      apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (k z)
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
      exact (min_eq_left (hN.trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hn))).symm
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hz.2 ht
  have hKU : K = U := hk.unique (hr.congr_ae hk.measurable heq)
  rwa [← hKU] at hU

omit [IsFiniteMeasure ν] in
theorem IsIntegralOperator.exists_positive_kernel (hK : IsIntegralOperator K) (hpos : 0 ≤ K) :
    ∃ k : X × Y → ℝ, IsIntegralKernel k K ∧ ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hK
  refine ⟨fun z => |k z|, ?_, fun z => abs_nonneg (k z)⟩
  simpa only [← abs_lOneOperator_eq, abs_of_nonneg hpos] using hk.modulus

theorem IsIntegralOperator.exists_rankOne_bounded_approximants
    (hK : IsIntegralOperator K) (hpos : 0 ≤ K) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → (Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν), Monotone T ∧
      (∀ n, 0 ≤ T n ∧ T n ≤ (n : ℝ) • integralRankOne μ ν ∧ IsIntegralOperator (T n)) ∧
      IsLUB (range T) K := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hkpos⟩ := hK.exists_positive_kernel hpos
  exact ⟨clippedIntegralOperator hk hkpos, clippedIntegralOperator_monotone hk hkpos,
    fun n => ⟨clippedIntegralOperator_nonneg hk hkpos n,
      clippedIntegralOperator_le_rankOne hk hkpos n,
      ⟨_, isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hkpos n⟩⟩,
    clippedIntegralOperator_isLUB hk hkpos⟩

theorem integralOperatorSubmodule_le_of_rankOne_mem
    {I : Submodule ℝ (Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν)} (hI : IsOrderClosedIdeal I)
    (hJ : integralRankOne μ ν ∈ I) : integralOperatorSubmodule μ ν ≤ I := by
  have hpositive : ∀ K : Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν,
      IsIntegralOperator K → 0 ≤ K → K ∈ I := by
    intro K hK hpos
    obtain ⟨T, hTm, hT, hsup⟩ := hK.exists_rankOne_bounded_approximants hpos
    apply hI.closed (range_nonempty T) _ _ _ hsup
    · rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact hI.nonneg_le_mem (I.smul_mem (n : ℝ) hJ) (hT n).1 (hT n).2.1
    · rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact (hT n).1
    · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩ _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨T (max m n), ⟨max m n, rfl⟩, hTm (le_max_left _ _), hTm (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  intro K hK
  change IsIntegralOperator K at hK
  have habs : |K| ∈ I := hpositive |K| hK.abs (abs_nonneg K)
  exact hI.solid habs (by simp)

theorem integralOperatorSubmodule_le_iff_rankOne_mem
    {I : Submodule ℝ (Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν)} (hI : IsOrderClosedIdeal I) :
    integralOperatorSubmodule μ ν ≤ I ↔ integralRankOne μ ν ∈ I :=
  ⟨fun h => h integralRankOne_isIntegral, integralOperatorSubmodule_le_of_rankOne_mem hI⟩

theorem integralOperatorSubmodule_isLeast_rankOne_band :
    IsLeast {I : Submodule ℝ (Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν) |
      IsOrderClosedIdeal I ∧ integralRankOne μ ν ∈ I} (integralOperatorSubmodule μ ν) :=
  ⟨⟨integralOperatorOrderClosedIdeal, integralRankOne_isIntegral⟩,
    fun _ hI => integralOperatorSubmodule_le_of_rankOne_mem hI.1 hI.2⟩

end ThesisCommon

as their actual order supremum. No topological or countability hypothesis is
used on the measure spaces. -/

declarations.label: clippedIntegralOperator_isLUB
declarations.code:
theorem clippedIntegralOperator_isLUB (hk : IsIntegralKernel k K)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) : IsLUB (range (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos)) K := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := lOneOperator_exists_isLUB (range_nonempty (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos))
    ⟨K, by rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩; exact clippedIntegralOperator_le hk hpos n⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _, hlimit⟩ := exists_integral_kernel_of_monotone_sup
    (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos) (fun n z => min (k z) (n : ℝ))
    (isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos)
    (clippedIntegralOperator_nonneg hk hpos) (clippedIntegralOperator_monotone hk hpos) hU
  have heq : r =ᵐ[μ.prod ν] k := by
    filter_upwards [hlimit] with z hz
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => min (k z) (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (k z)) := by
      apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (k z)
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
      exact (min_eq_left (hN.trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hn))).symm
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hz.2 ht
  have hKU : K = U := hk.unique (hr.congr_ae hk.measurable heq)
  rwa [← hKU] at hU

    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ k z) : IsLUB (range (clippedIntegralOperator hk hpos)) K

    fun n => ⟨clippedIntegralOperator_nonneg hk hkpos n,
      clippedIntegralOperator_le_rankOne hk hkpos n,
      ⟨_, isIntegralKernel_clippedIntegralOperator hk hkpos n⟩⟩,
    clippedIntegralOperator_isLUB hk hkpos⟩

declarations.name: integralOperatorSubmodule_le_of_rankOne_mem
declarations.label: integralOperatorSubmodule_le_of_rankOne_mem
declarations.code:
theorem integralOperatorSubmodule_le_of_rankOne_mem
    {I : Submodule ℝ (Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν)} (hI : IsOrderClosedIdeal I)
    (hJ : integralRankOne μ ν ∈ I) : integralOperatorSubmodule μ ν ≤ I := by
  have hpositive : ∀ K : Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν,
      IsIntegralOperator K → 0 ≤ K → K ∈ I := by
    intro K hK hpos
    obtain ⟨T, hTm, hT, hsup⟩ := hK.exists_rankOne_bounded_approximants hpos
    apply hI.closed (range_nonempty T) _ _ _ hsup
    · rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact hI.nonneg_le_mem (I.smul_mem (n : ℝ) hJ) (hT n).1 (hT n).2.1
    · rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact (hT n).1
    · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩ _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨T (max m n), ⟨max m n, rfl⟩, hTm (le_max_left _ _), hTm (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  intro K hK
  change IsIntegralOperator K at hK
  have habs : |K| ∈ I := hpositive |K| hK.abs (abs_nonneg K)
  exact hI.solid habs (by simp)

    {I : Submodule ℝ (Lp ℝ 1 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 ν)} (hI : IsOrderClosedIdeal I)
    (hJ : integralRankOne μ ν ∈ I) : integralOperatorSubmodule μ ν ≤ I
